equivalence_boundaries: Raw candidate_cells is a deterministic screening count, not a count of mathematically independent laws.
For binary tidal and merger indicators, any nonconstant monotone transform is affine-equivalent after training-fold standardization and a fitted scalar coefficient.
Phase is inert outside the log-periodic family; polarity duplicates are omitted because the fitted scalar coefficient absorbs sign.
Threshold, scale, and power cells that produce numerically identical components are one empirical equivalence class and may not be described as separate discoveries.
